summary: Retrieve the albums a user has added to their MyAlbums collection
description: Returns the list of Jamendo albums that a specific user has added to their MyAlbums relation. The request requires a client_id and at least one of id, access_token, or name to identify the user. Optional filters allow limiting, ordering, and selecting image sizes. The 'relation' parameter currently only supports 'myalbums'.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with json format and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200). The keyword 'all' is capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc for direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, includes 'results_fullcount' in the header (performance‑intensive; not available on heavy methods).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: relation
parameters.description: Relation type; currently only 'myalbums' is supported.

notes: client_id is mandatory; you must also supply at least one of id, access_token, or name to identify the user.
The 'order' field currently only accepts 'updatedate' but may support additional fields in the future.
Using 'fullcount' may impact performance and is not available for heavy endpoints.
